svg.aria-label: Agent Hub drawn as a circuit board. Phone, tablet and laptop reach the Hub on your PC over a private Tailscale network. The Hub has a 3D board, TALK and a router that sends each ask to the cheapest thing that can answer. From the router: autonomous LLM missions (missions, dispatch, a private worktree, review, apply), a team of agents with skills and a repair helper, PC control through Windows MCP, the media vault, and the git graph, which reads the worktrees.
svg.text: Runs on OpenCode, Claude Code or a local model. Your repo
is untouched until you press APPLY.
A team of agents that hand work on, skills you can add,
and a repair helper whose fixes you approve.
Windows only. Shell and registry tools are switched off.
Runs on your PC; copy results to your phone.
One dot per project, read straight from git, including the
Missions work on a copy; the Git Graph reads that copy.
